title: South Maui Community Plan review
summary: The committee deferred Bill 108, the South Maui Community Plan update, on October 8 after approving many text and policy changes, including a housing policy, a study of a County parcel near the Kīhei Police Station, and a data action on South Maui wildfires. Plan discussion continues October 21 and November 18, and a draft must be ready by December 2 to send to the next council. The gulch discussion will return when Public Works can attend.
